quantize_4bit: quantize a tensor using 4-bit quantization with nf4 or fp4 data types
dequantize_4bit: dequantize a packed 4-bit quantized tensor back to floating point
quantize_blockwise: quantize a tensor in blocks of values using blockwise quantization
dequantize_blockwise: dequantize a blockwise quantized tensor using absmax scaling
igemm: perform integer matrix multiplication using cuBLAS with int8 tensors
